creations.name: Decorative Junction Box Cover – Stylish Single-Color Solution for Electrical Installations - Daisy
creations.description:
For years, we’ve been using plain, standard, and mostly non-aesthetic junction box covers to conceal connection points in our home electrical installations. These covers are usually made of metal or plastic—functional, but visually uninspiring. That’s exactly why I designed decorative and stylish junction box covers to eliminate this unattractive look.

Features:
Produced in dimensions that fully cover the wall opening.

Consists of two parts: a decorative main piece and a U-shaped gripping piece.

The parts interlock securely for a firm fit.

Scaling is possible, but both parts must be resized proportionally.

Thanks to the 3MF file, you can print in a single color. Alternatively, you can paint it with acrylic markers.

For improved print quality, a 0.4mm nozzle with 0.12mm or 0.08mm layer height is recommended.

Variable layer height can be used for smoother results in curved areas.

No supports are required.

My models will be continuously updated and diversified. Please visit my profile to see all my designs. Feel free to share your requests, suggestions, and ideas.

Thank you!

creations.name: Case for the Wowstick 1F+ 69-in-1 Screwdriver Set
creations.description:
I designed an extremely practical case for the Wowstick 1F+ 69-in-1 screwdriver set. It consists of three parts in total: a top cover, a bottom cover, and two hinges. Thanks to the specially designed hinges, the top cover can remain open at a 90-degree angle.

I glued the hinges evenly in place, but you can also secure them with screws if you prefer. To ensure the top and bottom covers close securely, I used four round magnets. Additionally, I incorporated a strip magnet for the four long screwdriver bits that come with the Wowstick.

You can customize this case however you like.

Happy printing!
